authority_note: This register records only page-specific deltas established from the renewed split-PDF witness. It does not silently rewrite the heterogeneous summary/diplomatic layers in the existing clean batch.

deltas.existing_clean_key_text: Viññāṇa is temporally (?) antecedent to nāmarūpa and logically a subdivision of it.
deltas.direct_image_secure_key_text: viññāna is temporally (?) an antecedent of nāma-rūpam, & logically a subdivision of it.
deltas.correction: The relation phrase is diplomatically ‘an antecedent of’, not ‘antecedent to’. The manuscript also uses the form ‘nāma-rūpam’ in this sentence; normalized conceptual prose may continue to use nāmarūpa if explicitly marked as normalization.
deltas.material_layout_observation: The diagram immediately above nests viññānam under nāma within nāmarūpam while the prose assigns temporal antecedence and logical subdivision. No visible erasure removes either relation.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: The prior relation-type argument survives; the correction is diplomatic rather than conceptual.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for key rejection/conclusion; W2 for the crossed/overwritten temporal-homogeneity phrase immediately above
deltas.existing_clean_key_text: there is, he argues, a discoverable technical system underlying the arrangement.
deltas.direct_image_secure_key_text: There is a discoverable logical system wh. governs the arrangement, and the repetitions are intentional; as I hope I have succeeded in showing.
deltas.additional_secure_text: The page directly rejects the claim that the formula is ‘illogical & unintelligible’ or that its terms were ‘jumbled together in an order more or less accidental.’
deltas.correction: Replace the normalized descriptor ‘technical system’ with the manuscript’s ‘logical system’ when representing Lovejoy’s own wording or conceptual vocabulary.
deltas.hold: Do not freeze the exact crossed/overwritten word(s) in the immediately preceding clause about the sequence being non-homogeneous / not strictly temporal until a still tighter paleographic read is needed for quotation.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: This materially strengthens the claim that Lovejoy’s local problem is one of relation and intelligible arrangement, not merely technical taxonomy. It does not establish a later unit-idea method or a Buddhist origin for it.

deltas.direct_image_secure_fragment: precede both temporally as well as logically
deltas.correction: The existing clean summary’s distinction between temporal and logical precedence is directly supported by the page image rather than being an editorial synthesis.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: p.50 independently repeats the relation-type vocabulary found on p.42, reducing the chance that ms p.123 is an isolated formulation.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for heading/source anchor and high-level genealogy; W2 for some compressed technical forms

deltas.interpretive_consequence: The page makes the historical-genealogical question distinct from the logical-arrangement question secured on pp.49-50.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for the key evaluative transitions; W2 for several compressed middle clauses
direct_image_secure_fragments: the whole enumeration is secondary as to origin & composite as to character
deltas.correction: The clean summary is conceptually sustained: Lovejoy distinguishes composite/secondary origin from the later scholastic work of making the inherited terms cohere. No stronger direct-borrowing claim is licensed.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: The local sequence now separates at least three questions: historical origin, logical arrangement, and scholastic reconciliation. These should not be flattened into one chronology or one contradiction claim.
